bio: Isobel currently teaches A-level English Language and English Literature at a top sixth-form college, rated "Outstanding" by Ofsted, where she is Head of English Language and Literature.
She is an examiner for AQA, so she knows exactly how answers are marked against the levels and bands.
Isobel is a highly experienced, expert teacher who tutors A-level and GCSE English Language and English Literature.
